name: WordForm
author: softcoy

sections.description:
WordForm is a modern drag-and-drop WordPress form builder for contact forms, lead forms, booking forms, surveys, upload forms, payment forms, and connected workflows. It gives site owners a clean form-building experience inside wp-admin without requiring custom code.

The free version is designed to be useful from the first install. Build forms visually, publish them with a block or shortcode, collect submissions in WordPress, send email notifications, protect forms from spam, accept selected payments, and connect selected workflows.

WordForm also keeps important WordForm Pro tools visible as locked previews, so you can plan advanced fields, additional gateways, CRM connections, automation, reporting, and support upgrades before moving to Pro.

Learn more about premium features on the WordForm Pro product page: https://softcoy.com/products/wordform-pro.

Features

Visual form building

  • Build forms with a drag-and-drop editor made for WordPress users.
  • Create contact forms, lead forms, booking forms, surveys, upload forms, payment forms, and custom workflow forms.
  • Use responsive field widths for full, half, and one-third layouts.
  • Add labels, help text, default values, required states, and custom CSS classes.
  • Create multi-step forms with previous and next navigation.
  • Start faster with ready-made form templates.
  • Publish forms with the WordForm block or generated shortcode.
  • Review stored submissions directly inside wp-admin.
  • Send email notifications for new submissions.
  • Configure validation messages, submit button styling, uploads, captcha, payments, and integrations from global settings.

Included free fields

  • Text, textarea, number, URL, and hidden fields.
  • Name, address, select, checkbox, radio, and range fields.
  • Date and time fields with frontend picker UI.
  • Image upload with free-tier file controls.
  • Terms, GDPR consent, section, and HTML fields.
  • Numeric captcha, Google reCAPTCHA, and hCaptcha fields.
  • Payment item, custom amount, quantity, summary, payment method, Stripe, and PayPal elements.

Payments and integrations

  • Accept payments with Stripe and PayPal.
  • Connect forms to Google Sheets.
  • Send form data to Custom Webhook endpoints.
  • Store connection status and send-result data for supported free integrations.
  • Keep forms and submissions safe during plugin updates with versioned database upgrade handling.

WordForm Pro previews

WordForm Free shows premium tools as locked previews, so users can understand the full product before upgrading. Pro previews include email, tel, datetime, rating, signature, Likert / matrix, rich text editor, coupons, Square, Authorize.Net, Google Calendar, Zapier, Slack, Make, Mailchimp, MailerLite, Brevo, Airtable, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, payment reports, advanced connection logs, and enhanced support diagnostics.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for WordForm.
  3. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  4. You can also upload the plugin folder manually to /wp-content/plugins/wordform/ and activate it from Plugins.
  5. Go to WordForm > All Forms.
  6. Create a new form, customize the fields, save it, and publish it with the WordForm block or shortcode.
  7. Review WordForm > Settings for captcha, upload, payment, notification, and integration options.
sections.faq:
What can I build with WordForm?

You can build contact forms, lead forms, booking forms, surveys, upload forms, payment forms, and custom workflow forms.

Can I embed forms in posts and pages?

Yes. You can attach forms with the WordForm block in the block editor or use the generated shortcode from the forms list.

Can I edit forms after they are published?

Yes. When you update a form, the embedded post, page, or shortcode output uses the latest saved version automatically.

Does the free version support multi-step forms?

Yes. WordForm includes multi-step form support with previous and next navigation.

Which payment gateways are included in the free version?

Stripe and PayPal are included in the free version. Square and Authorize.Net are shown as Pro previews.

Which integrations are included in the free version?

Google Sheets and Custom Webhook are included in the free version. Additional marketing, CRM, automation, and calendar connectors are available in WordForm Pro.

Can I protect forms from spam?

Yes. WordForm includes numeric captcha, Google reCAPTCHA, and hCaptcha options.

Can I receive submission data by email?

Yes. Enable email notification settings to receive submission data in your inbox.

Can I customize validation messages and submit button style?

Yes. WordForm includes settings for validation messages and submit button appearance.

What happens when I update WordForm through the WordPress plugin update system?

WordForm keeps your existing forms and submissions. New database tables or columns are applied through the plugin update path without requiring you to deactivate and reactivate the plugin.

Where can I learn about WordForm Pro?

Visit the WordForm Pro product page for premium fields, integrations, payments, reports, and support features: https://softcoy.com/products/wordform-pro.
sections.changelog:
3.0.1

  • Minor bug fixed

3.0.0

  • Major free release with refreshed WordForm admin screenshots, release metadata, and WordPress.org readme presentation.
  • Improved the visual builder experience with clearer drag-and-drop panels, responsive layout guidance, form templates, and live field option controls.
  • Expanded the free feature set around multi-step forms, Date and Time fields, image upload controls, numeric captcha, Google reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Stripe, PayPal, Google Sheets, and Custom Webhook.
  • Added clearer free-to-Pro previews for premium fields, advanced payment options, integrations, reporting, connection logs, and support upgrades.
  • Improved Forms, Submissions, Settings, Integrations, Support, and Go Pro admin pages so users can better understand included free features and available upgrade paths.
  • Updated plugin version alignment for the 3.0.0 release so admin support diagnostics and release metadata show the current free version.
  • Updated release metadata so the runtime plugin version follows the readme stable tag.
  • Updated WordPress.org screenshot assets to full-page plugin admin views.

2.0.3

  • Added expanded free-tier form building with multi-step forms, Date and Time fields, hCaptcha, Google reCAPTCHA, image upload controls, Stripe, PayPal, Google Sheets, and Custom Webhook.
  • Added locked WordForm Pro previews for premium fields, advanced payments, integrations, reporting, and support surfaces.
  • Improved payment settings with guided Stripe and PayPal setup for free users and locked Square and Authorize.Net previews.
  • Improved date/time picker behavior, upload limits, captcha configuration, support diagnostics, and submission handling.
  • Improved database schema upgrades so new tables and columns are applied during plugin updates without reactivation.
  • Removed outdated tutorial video links from the readme.

2.0.2

  • Fixed minor Google reCAPTCHA bugs.

  • Fixed minor bugs.
  • Added more numeric captcha templates.

  • Improved browser compatibility for form submissions.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added drag-and-drop form builder.
  • Added email notifications for submitted form data.
  • Added dashboard submission data management.
  • Added submit button styling controls.
  • Added custom validation messages.
  • Added block editor and shortcode embed support.
  • Added numeric captcha field.
